correctness.rationale: The normalization by a triangular change of q and a translation of p is valid. For normalized W=A(p)q+R(p) with degree A=d at least 2 and degree R below d, the total-degree filtration gives d deg(P)+deg(Q)=d+1 for an isotropy automorphism, forcing both generator images to have degree one. Unique factorization of the leading form forces the linear part to be diagonal; the missing \(p^{d-1}\) coefficient then forces zero translation, and the lower-degree comparison forces zero q-translation. The remaining coefficient conditions give exactly the stated finite cyclic group. Iterating ad_W on p raises polynomial degree by d-1 each time, proving non-local-finiteness. The constant and linear branches agree with the established normal forms.
